recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a man with braided hair wearing a large leather coat, set against a stark white background. The image features a distinct split between a fluid, handwritten-style title at the top and a blocky, distressed stencil-like subtitle at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia subject against a cold white void
Organic curves of the subject vs. rigid distressed typography
High-key background emphasizing the dark, textured leather
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows in the leather folds
High-contrast lighting from the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, cropped from the waist up, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, looking downward in a pensive expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right script, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the leather jacket to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides creates a clean, modern frame for the gritty subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers (subject and leather)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones of the skin; extreme value contrast between subject and background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Fluid, monolinear script with overlapping loops and a hand-drawn feel.
Bottom text: Heavy, blocky slab-serif with intentional weathering and stencil-like gaps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature elongated tails and connected loops.
Block letters have eroded edges and internal texture to mimic old print.

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the base of the portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, personal script and industrial, weathered block type.

preserve: The contrast between the two font styles

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the top text.
Matches the heavy, distressed feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast studio portrait of a man with cornrows looking down, wearing a dark, textured leather trench coat. The lighting is warm and amber-toned. The background is pure, flat white. The image should have a slight film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a fluid, hand-drawn script title in the top right corner with a thin dark outline. Add a heavy, distressed stencil-style subtitle across the bottom, centered, with wide letter spacing and a weathered texture.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone warm and amber?
Does the bottom text look eroded or stenciled?
Is the top text fluid and script-like?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the bottom typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the leather jacket has visible highlights and deep shadows.
Check that the script text does not look like a standard computer font.
Verify the white background is clean and lacks artifacts.
Confirm the warm color temperature is consistent across the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast warm-toned portrait against a white void with a dual-typographic system: one fluid script and one weathered industrial block.
